summary: A member uses some of their own speaking time to let a colleague make a case.
realLife: During the King County Council endorsement debate, Art Chippendale spoke for a candidate and yielded part of his time to Chris Porter.
inGame: needs: the speaking order, remaining time and the person recognized to use it.

turns.writesBack: The shared turn ends at the original deadline.

turns.pulledBy: The original speaker has used the allotted time.
